errors.evidence: The data for the 'Regular members' line, as with all lines, does not start at epoch 0. The data points begin at approximately epoch 0.25.
The 'Held-out data' line (green) does not remain between 0.03 and 0.04. It dips to a value of approximately 0.02 around epoch 1.75.
The color of the 'Regular members' line is a very dark navy blue, which could also be described as black. 'Solid blue' is a borderline description.
The 'Members with near-duplicates' line (orange) starts closer to 0.025 or 0.03, making 'near 0.02' a slight underestimate.
The 'Held-out data' line (green) starts closer to 0.025, making 'near 0.03' a slight overestimate.
